_how: TODD's monologue before the fight. Each line is typed out while his screen shows what's in 'show' (one after another, if there's more than one): a picture from 'pictures', or 'face:NAME' for one of his own faces (smile, neutral, happy, angry, surprised, sly, sad, error, loading). 'pose' is what his body does: lean, preach, slump, point, peer, rage, palm or look. 'shake' is a word that shakes the screen when it's typed; 'on_shake' is a picture that takes over his screen at that moment. 'secs' is how long the line stays. After the last line he throws his arms in the air and the fight starts. Pictures with 'urls' load from Wikimedia while the page runs (never copied into the repo); 'drawn' ones are made from the site's own art. 'focus' ([x, y], 0 to 1 from the top left) is the part of a picture to keep in the middle when it's cropped to his screen.

lines.text: I was GOD once. GOD of VARANDIA.
Banished to this realm of despair and misery.
The Salesman and Wonder, here too.

_how2: 'title' is the card before the fight (click to start). 'death' is the card when you die: 'heading', and one of 'quotes' (TODD talking) picked at random. 'win' is the banner when you beat him. These are drafts: rewrite them.

death.heading: YOU DIED
quotes: Go back to your two dimensions.
Was that it? Was THAT it?

_how3: 'death' (the skull) is what his screen shows when you beat him. 'fire' is still there to use in a line.
_how4: 'taunt_pictures': what his screen can flash while he taunts you. 'damage_pictures': what flickers across his screen as you wear him down (more and more often the more he's hurt); 'agony' is his agony face.
_how5: 'eggs': rare Easter-egg pictures. Now and then one replaces a damage flash or a taunt picture (held a little longer), and there's a small chance one sneaks into a line of the monologue. 'fill' stretches a picture's own background to the edges of his screen.
no_parry: (Nothing to parry with. You need something that can take a hit.)
no_parry_tip: You can't parry without the Clear Polaroid or the Dubbed Tape.
_how6: 'no_parry' shows (now and then) when you try to parry without the Clear Polaroid or the Dubbed Tape; 'no_parry_tip' goes on the death card. 'gone' is the title once he's been beaten (rp_flags.todd_dead): no START, just him, dead. These are drafts.
